title: fix(plugin-security,spec): the grant remedy texts name the reviewed-plan ceremony; C7b wording follow-ups in cli, plugin-auth and the durability vocabularies (#23513)
body:
Fixes #23513
Clause-②: no

Item 1 of the card, the `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` rule, is carried by #23615 under ruling D of #23579 (ruling of record 6184818831). #23615 remains open, and this PR touches nothing under `skills/**`. This PR carries items 2 and 3. Text only: no behaviour changes.

## Item 2: the remedy texts name the reviewed-plan ceremony (commit 559a578314)

Since S4 (`f9b421716d`), `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` refuses a run without `--plan-file`. Two texts from #23503 still told the operator to run `--apply` alone:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/catalog-reference-report.ts`, `logReport`: the boot error line for grants that name no permission set.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ups-permission-set-id-column-retired.ts`: the entry's `replacement`, the row the upgrade guide prints.

Both now name the two steps. First plan, `os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json`, and review the file it writes. Then run `os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken --plan-file plan.json`, which executes that plan, and restart. The line's level, its fields, and the entry's `id`, `surface`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` are unchanged.

`.changeset/23513-grant-remedy-plan-file.md` releases both packages as a `patch`. Under the WHICH LEVEL rule this changes no public surface.

**Spelling: the plan step is not `--plan`.** The card and the dispatch spelled the plan step `os migrate organization-ownership --plan`. The CLI has no `--plan` flag. ADR-0131 calls the bare run "`--plan`", and the command's flags are `--out`, `--json`, `--apply`, `--plan-file` and the rest. Measured against the built CLI at this head:

- `os migrate organization-ownership --plan` exits 2 with `Nonexistent flag: --plan. The command never ran`.
- `os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken` exits 1 with `Refused: --apply executes only a plan you reviewed. Run the plan first (os migrate organization-ownership, ...), review the file it writes, then re-run --apply with --plan-file FILE.`

So both texts use `--out plan.json` for the plan step. That is the spelling of S4's own ADR-0087 entry, `cli-organization-ownership-apply-plan-file-required`. The dispatch's intent is kept: a plan step, then `--apply --plan-file` with the reviewed file.

## Item 3: stale wording (commit 02ab85b28b)

- `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-grants.ts` (`grantKey`) and `organization-ownership-plan.ts` (`GrantKeyPlan`): these comments said a NULL organization is keyed "as the write door keys it". The write door is retired. The text now says it is keyed as the grant's `unique: 'organization'` index keys it, because the index's organization key part is NULL-safe (ADR-0120 D3).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.test.ts`: one test title said GROUP BY keys NULLs together "unlike the index". It now says "as the index's NULL-safe organization key part does". Only the title changes; the assertions are the same.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/grant-set-name.ts`: the module header said C8 drops `permission_set_id`, and that a one-time boot backfill names legacy grants. It now says C7b retired the column, that no boot names a grant, and that the v18 ceremony's verified rewrite names one or lists it with its reason.
- `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` (`DURABILITY_CRITICAL_CALLEES`) and `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` (`WRITE_SHAPED_CALLEES`): `persistGrantNameBackfillRecord` is removed from both. #23503 deleted its only definition. The two lists must change together, because the census cross-checks its copy against the gate's declaration.

## Verification at head 02ab85b28b

- **Build:** `turbo run build --concurrency=2` over `@objectstack/cli...`, `@objectstack/plugin-security...`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth...` and `@objectstack/spec...` (the packages and their upstream dependencies): 61 of 61 tasks passed.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter PKG run typecheck` for plugin-security, plugin-auth, cli and spec all exit 0. The test-layer typecheck is OK in all four.
- **Tests:**
  - plugin-security: 185 files, 3690 passed, 45 skipped.
  - plugin-auth: 145 files, 2845 passed, 10 skipped.
  - spec (`--project local`, after `gen:migration-registry`): 678 files, 20728 passed, 1 todo.
  - cli: `organization-ownership-apply.test.ts` and `-column-drops.test.ts` run under `--project integration`, the tier they belong to and the tier the edited test file is in: 2 files, 99 passed. The renamed test passes under its new title (`-t 'NULL-safe organization key part'`, verbose). The cli `unit` tier was **not** run in full here: it went over the 10-minute foreground limit on a shared box, and CI runs it.
  - The tests that read the two edited scripts: metadata-protocol `sys-metadata-repository.draft-drain.test.ts` and `protocol.metadata-store-outage.test.ts` (43 passed), and runtime `http-dispatcher.keys.test.ts` (20 passed).
- **The two durability scripts:**
  - `pnpm check:durability-log-level` exits 0. Its self-tests pass: 68 log-level cases and 57 read-seam cases. Verdict: 46 durability-critical catch seams, all loud, rethrowing or propagating.
  - `pnpm check:swallow-census-controls` (`--self-test=gated`) and `node scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs --self-test` both exit 0, with "24 copied gate-vocabulary name(s) match the gate's own declaration".
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 114 commands. All 114 were run, each exit code was recorded, and `--ran` reports: "114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".
  - These include `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1841 cases).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: some packages outside this diff had no `dist`. A later gate in the same run built those packages. Both were re-run at this head and exit 0. The recorded codes are from the re-runs.
  - `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, which the derivation does not place, was also run: exit 0.
- **Lint, narrowed to the 8 changed source files:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Three facts show the narrowing leaves nothing out:
  - All 8 files are inside the config's lint set: `ESLint.isPathIgnored` answers false.
  - The JSON output counts 8 files.
  - `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- **The pending #23503 note, `.changeset/23430-grant-permission-set-id-retired.md`, is corrected in commits 55725c1d79 and a618e1735c (the PM's answer A).** It is still pending in `.changeset/`, not `.changeset/pre/`. Exactly two sentences change. In the FROM → TO list, "→ `os migrate organization-ownership --apply`." becomes "→ the v18 ceremony: plan it with `os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json`, review the file it writes, then run `os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken --plan-file plan.json`." Under "What else changes", "`os migrate organization-ownership --plan` reports a `grants` block" becomes "The plan run, `os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json`, reports a `grants` block". `Check Changeset` stays red by design: this is a DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending note that another PR changed, and the seat confirms it at ACCEPT. Changeset checks at a618e1735c: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1 (expected), and its `--self-test` exits 0. `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and its `--self-test` both exit 0.
- **Left as written:**
  - Comments and docs that name `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` as the step that performs the rewrite, not as a command to run: `security-plugin.ts`, two plugin-security test headers, the plugin-auth reader header, and `content/docs/permissions/{permission-sets,capabilities}.mdx`.
  - The same entry's `acceptanceCriteria`, which says what is true after `--apply` has run.
- **No pin was added.** No test asserts the text of the unnamed-grant line or the entry's `replacement`, so the dispatch's rule (pin only a text that a test asserts) adds none.
- **Seat 1's S2 (#23469)** may also edit `organization-ownership-plan.ts`. This PR changes only the `GrantKeyPlan` doc comment there, and `main` was not merged.
